locator: Nestlé BMS Index 2024 scorecard, sections « Country Studies overview » and « Main in-country findings »
summary: ATNi reports 219 observations of non-compliant marketing practices for Nestlé across China, Germany, Indonesia, the United States and Viet Nam. It records 89 product labels assessed and observations across online and traditional media; 109 of the 219 observations were identified through online social listening.
limitations: ATNi notes that the assessment is limited by the five selected markets, the available product-label images and data collection. The index assesses alignment with the WHO Code, not national law.
